title: Dört Kapı Bir Oda
author: Dilek Yeşilbaş
description: Four Doors, One Room: Living with Bipolar Disorder invites readers to view bipolar disorder through a deeply human lens—not merely as a diagnosis, but as a lived experience and a reflection of life’s diversity. Written in clear and accessible language by psychiatrist Dr. Dilek Yeşilbaş, the book reveals the lives behind the label. Through four interconnected stories, each symbolized by a door opening into the therapy room, the book explores different forms of bipolar disorder and related conditions, shedding light on family life, parenthood, work, social relationships, and societal attitudes.
english_title: Four Doors, One Room: Living with Bipolar Disorder
